title: Exit-Seeking at Care Facility
situation: Mom keeps trying to leave the memory care facility. She stands by the door and waits for someone to open it, then tries to slip out. She tells staff she needs to go home to cook dinner for her family. This is the third time today.

patient_profile.name: Dorothy
behavioral_patterns: believes she needs to fulfill homemaker role
becomes agitated when redirected from doors
calming_strategies: giving her a basket of towels to fold
asking her to help set the table
safety_concerns: has made it outside twice before

notes: Should use purposeful activity redirection (towel folding, table setting). Should NOT say 'you live here now' or 'you can't leave'. Should validate her desire to care for family.
